title: 11/19/2018: ZAYO, BX, KKR, AAPL, SOL, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.45%
AAPL: -1.95%
IBM: -0.22%
CSCO: -0.30%
GOOG: -0.22%
Tech stocks were mixed in early Monday trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Zayo Group Holdings ( ZAYO ), which was up by more than 9% after reports that it has drawn takeover interest from buyout firms Blackstone ( BX ) and KKR ( KKR ) and Stonepeak Partners. The Boulder, Colo.-based communications infrastructure services provider unveiled plans earlier this month to split into publicly traded companies.
In other sector news:
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) was lower by more than 1% after the Wall Street Journal reported that the company has trimmed production orders for its three recently released iPhone models as the technology company grapples with lower-than-expected demand for the devices.
(=) ReneSola ( SOL ) was unchanged as its Q3 earnings and revenue declined from the comparable quarter last year, and it provided revenue guidance for Q4.
